content: The OneTouch Ultra is a blood glucose monitoring device specifically designed for individuals with diabetes. It serves as the foundational product in LifeScan's OneTouch Ultra family of blood glucose monitoring systems. The OneTouch Ultra Blood Glucose Meters deliver blood glucose test results within 5 seconds, offer the option for alternate testing sites, and include various memory and flagging features to enhance usability. OneTouch meters are sold as part of kits that include a carrying case, a lancing device, control solution, sample quantities of lancets, and a replacement cap for alternate site testing with the sampling device. The OneTouch Ultra 2 meter shares a similar design and operational functionality with the original OneTouch Ultra meter but introduces additional features such as Before and After Meal flags, the ability to add comments, and a list-style memory recall. It also provides 7-day, 14-day, and 30-day averages, with the capability to calculate averages specifically for Before Meal or After Meal records. Other models in the OneTouch Ultra series include the OneTouch UltraSmart and the OneTouch UltraMini meters, the latter of which is marketed as the OneTouch UltraEasy in Europe. In addition to the original Silver Moon color, LifeScan introduced three new colors for the OneTouch UltraMini meter in the summer of 2007: Pink Glow, Limelight, and Jet Black. OneTouch meters equipped with data ports can be used in conjunction with the downloadable OneTouch Diabetes Management Software and a PC to compute averages and identify trends in blood glucose levels. While the software is available for download from LifeScan's website, an interface cable must be purchased separately. B.B. King, who has lived with diabetes for over 10 years, participated in an advertising campaign for the OneTouch Ultra. In the campaign, he shared his experiences with diabetes, describing the emotional challenges he faced. The campaign also featured a commercial with King and a younger individual with diabetes, both of whom played blues music, promoting the use of alternate site testing. Patti LaBelle, who has had diabetes for over 12 years, was featured in an advertising campaign for the OneTouch Ultra 2. She recounted a personal story of collapsing on stage, which led to her diabetes diagnosis. As part of the campaign, LaBelle re-recorded her 1980s hit song New Attitude for one of the commercials. Additionally, OneTouch serves as the main shirt sponsor for Inverness Caledonian Thistle, a football club, highlighting LifeScan's significant presence as a major employer in the city.
